summary: Cohort offboarding: reconcile delayed device returns, reconcile asset DB and embargo service accounts
description:
Issue summary: A cohort of 18 contractors (end date 2026-03-10) was scheduled for coordinated offboarding. HR confirms exit processed in AD, but the asset inventory and service-account embargo steps show partial completion. Several devices remain marked 'with employee' in inventory; two service accounts for ephemeral CI runners were not suspended. Goal: reconcile physical device returns, validate remote wipe, ensure service-account embargo and rotate affected KMS keys as required.

Impact: Potential security exposure from active service accounts and unreturned devices; accounting discrepancies for hardware; possible licensing overages. Risk rated high because cohort had elevated access to several internal buckets and a dedicated GPU lab pool.
impact: Unreturned devices (estimated 6/18) + 2 active service accounts used by contractors. Security exposure window unknown; HR completed termination but automation flows did not fully complete. Financial impact from missing assets and potential license costs if devices remain assigned. Requires coordinated SRE, IAM, and Facilities involvement.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) HR processed termination for contractor cohort (batch job hr.offboard.batch/2026-03-10).
2) Offboarding automation runs: AD disable, SCIM deprovision -> succeeded for all accounts.
3) Asset-recovery webhook invoked to mark devices 'return_requested' -> 12 marked complete, 6 still 'with employee'.
4) IAM embargo playbook executed -> two ephemeral service accounts (ci-runner-17, ci-runner-22) report active tokens in Secrets Manager.
5) Attempts to trigger remote-wipe for remaining devices via MDM returned 'device unreachable' for four devices.
logs: Relevant logs and links: HR batch job run: hr-ops/2026-03-10-termination.log (S3). Offboard automation run id: offb-20260310-09:12. Asset-sync job logs: asset-sync-20260310.log (contains payload and response codes). Secrets Manager audit: secrets-audit-2026-03-11.csv shows ci-runner-17 token create 2026-03-09. Facilities intake tickets created: FAC-2026-0312-78.
investigation_notes:
- IAM: SCIM deprovision succeeded but downstream scripts that call asset-sync webhook timed out intermittently (timeouts observed on 3 nodes).
- Asset service reported 504s during batch and later reconciled some devices but not all; devices with offline MDM clients remained 'with employee'.
- Secrets Manager shows active tokens for two ephemeral accounts; initial token revocation failed due to missing service-account owner metadata.
- KMS: two keys were used by contractors for experimental model tests; no key compromise detected but rotation is recommended after service-account embargo.
- Hypothesis: network congestion in us-east region during batch window caused partial automation failures; retry logic didn't backfill asset state for devices unreachable by MDM.
workaround: Manual steps executed to reduce exposure: 1) Support temporarily disabled the two CI service accounts and added short-lived deny policy for any remaining tokens. 2) Facilities contacted contractors with outstanding devices to schedule courier pickups. 3) MDM remote-wipe retried outside business hours to catch devices that appear online. These reduce immediate risk while full reconciliation proceeds.
resolution: In progress: - Diego performed manual suspension of ci-runner-17 and ci-runner-22 and rotated associated tokens. - Facilities confirmed pickup for 4 devices scheduled 2026-03-15. - Asset DB will be reconciled once devices are received and MDM confirms wipe. - Planned KMS rotation for affected test keys scheduled 2026-03-16 during low traffic window. Final verification required before closing ticket.
follow_up_tasks: 1) Owner: Inventory team to update asset DB after physical intake (due 2026-03-18). 2) IAM to implement validation to prevent token revocation when owner metadata missing (PR in infra:5123). 3) Automation: add exponential backoff and a post-batch reconciliation job to capture devices with 'device unreachable' state. 4) Security: complete KMS rotation and publish rotation report to Confluence. 5) HR: confirm contractors received return-label emails and follow up on any disputes.
